_how_to_add: Add one object per game to 'games'. Fields: id (unique slug), title, blurb (one sentence), url (relative page, e.g. games/xyz.html, or https://...), tag (optional short label), status ('live' or 'soon'). While the list is empty the page shows the 'New games dropping soon' panel.

games.title: UFC Fighter Trivia
games.blurb: Champions, results, records and UFC history in 10-question rounds: Easy, Medium, Hard and a daily challenge.

games.title: UFC Card Builder
games.blurb: Be the matchmaker: build a fight card from current UFC fighters, get a hype score and card grade, then simulate it.

games.title: Career Mode
games.blurb: Create a fighter and climb from the regional circuit to world champion and the Hall of Fame.

games.title: GM Mode
games.blurb: Run an MMA management stable: scout hidden gems, negotiate purses and collect belts across divisions.
